basics.name: Kamal Alhumsi
basics.title: Product Engineer & Founder
basics.summary: Engineer turned founder with 8+ years of experience building and shipping digital products. Co-founded VAN HOMSI, a CGI studio, and helped a former employer achieve a **7-figure exit**. Experienced across social media, SaaS, and creative industries, with a strong full-stack background in React, Node.js, TypeScript, and modern cloud infrastructure. Skilled at taking ideas from early validation and market positioning through to production delivery.

technicalSkills.items: React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt.js, Gatsby, Tailwind CSS, MUI
Node.js, Fastify, Laravel, Express.js, GraphQL, Apollo, REST APIs
BigQuery, Firestore, GCP Cloud Functions, event pipeline design, SQL aggregation, data partitioning & clustering, ETL workflows
Mixpanel, React-based BI dashboards, data-driven product decisions
Unit testing, test case design (Jest ecosystem)

work.name: Van Homsi
highlights: Co-founded a CGI production studio specialising in photorealistic commercial content for cosmetics and fragrance brands; acquired and delivered projects for clients in France and Italy (Majouri Paris, HFC Paris, Noeme Paris, Officina Delle Essenze).
Owned end-to-end operations: led sales conversations with international clients, scoped projects, managed production pipeline, and handled client feedback and iteration.
Developed market positioning strategy through iterative hypothesis testing, establishing product-market fit in the competitive luxury CGI market.
Led content creation and marketing, growing the brand to **53,000+ Instagram followers**.
Managed full recruitment cycle for the studio's first hire: sourcing, screening, interviewing, and selecting a 3D artist.

work.name: Hashtagfox (Boost App Social)
highlights: Led the full development process: supervised junior developers, created technical tasks with the founder and design team, reviewed pull requests, and evaluated technical solutions.

Architected and owned end-to-end business intelligence infrastructure: built an event processing pipeline (GCP Cloud Functions, Firestore, BigQuery) handling +10 million events; designed SQL aggregation queries with data partitioning and clustering, **reducing costs by 46%** and accelerating processing 6x.
Developed a React-based BI dashboard providing insights that enabled data-driven decisions, contributing to **more than a million app installs**.
Built an internal email customer support platform (similar to Zendesk) for support teams using React.js.
Solely built an internal task manager with real-time updates and activity logs using TypeScript, React, Node.js, and Firebase.
Developed multiple payment interfaces using Stripe Elements and standalone Stripe integration.
work.stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt.js, MUI, Node.js, Fastify, Gatsby, Tailwind, Firebase, GCP, BigQuery, Mixpanel, CI/CD

work.name: Team4Hire
highlights: Developed high-level microservices APIs using PHP and Laravel.
Built applications with modern CI/CD pipelines and an iterative development process.
Wrote unit tests and designed test cases across multiple projects.

work.name: Corptia
highlights: Invited by the founders to join as a front-end developer; developed a Vue.js admin panel boilerplate with complex components including a CRUD-generator, prioritising reusability and performance.
Established a GraphQL-based development workflow using fragments and aliases; collaborated closely with design and backend teams on interface launches.
Provided technical support to the mobile team on Git and GraphQL usage.
work.stack: Vue, GraphQL, Apollo, Nuxt.js, Node.js, Express.js, Tailwind

work.name: Baianat
highlights: Started career as the youngest hire in a 30+ person software company (hired professionally at age 16).
Completed tasks across multiple projects alongside senior developers, gaining broad frontend and backend exposure.
work.stack: Vue, GraphQL, Apollo, Nuxt.js, Node.js, Express.js, Sass

education.description: I am a self-taught software engineer with a non-traditional background. My academic path was interrupted after my family fled Syria in 2013, and I entered the workforce at the age of 16 to support them. Since then, I have built my career through hands-on experience, developing my skills in real-world environments. Growing up in this context required constant adaptation, which shaped my ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
Completed the Forward Incubator accelerator program and won first place in the technology track.

additionalExperience: Vuesax RTL Support: Solely added RTL (right-to-left) support to the open-source Vuesax UI library.
Turning E-commerce: Built a Progressive Web App as an assessment for Turing.com, demonstrating advanced frontend architecture.
Hacktoberrank: Contributed UI for ranking all participants in Hacktoberfest 2019.
awards: Helped former employer (Hashtagfox) achieve a 7-figure exit.
Grew Van Homsi to 53,000+ Instagram followers and secured long-term partnerships with luxury brands in France and Italy.
Started writing code at age 13 (first language: Ruby); hired professionally at 16 — youngest hire in a 30+ person company.
